Changes, all for U05:
- `CatalogScreen.kt`: the list area now shows a spinner while loading, an error message when the load failed, and "catalog is empty" or "No books match" text when there is nothing to list. The search box stays visible in every state.
- `CatalogViewModel.kt`: `load()` is wrapped in try/catch so a failure is recorded instead of crashing the coroutine. I added `isLoading` and `loadError` as read-only state. The existing `books`, `query` and `onQueryChange` API is unchanged.

The view model change is outside the one file you named. The screen cannot detect a failed load without it, so I made it. I could not build or run the project here, so this is unverified by compilation.
